market.funding_schedule: provider-native; 8h nominal (00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC via funding_interval_hours); SOLUSDT 2022-11 provider 2h/4h schedule honoured per row, never assumed 8h
market.asset_selection_rule: All three assets of the frozen ARC universe are traded; no asset may be dropped using outcome information after execution begins

funding_authority.timestamp_semantics: funding_time_ms == availability_time_ms == settlement_time_ms; funding is knowable exactly at settlement; next_funding_time_ms is derived and IS NOT an observation
funding_authority.quality: PASS (0 missing settlements, 0 conflicting duplicates, 0 non-finite, monotonic)

oi_authority.ledger_role: FORENSIC_ONLY: OI_ARCHIVE_DAY_VALIDITY_LEDGER_V2 MUST NOT gate historical decision eligibility
oi_authority.quality: PASS_WITH_EXPLICIT_GAPS (documented invalid days; no synthesis, no interpolation)

price_authority.source: official data.binance.vision klines_1h archives + frozen H1 authority, overlap verified PASS
price_authority.quality: PASS (0 missing hours in common window, 0 duplicates)

common_window.derivation: INTERSECTION of certified funding, OI and price authorities (latest start, earliest end), expressed on the price authority's 1h bar-OPEN timeline
common_window.bound_semantics: CLOSED interval on 1h bar OPEN times: bar_open_time in [start_ms, end_ms]. Bars are indexed by open_time; a bar spans [open_time, open_time + 3600000).
common_window.price_extension_hours_beyond_oi_end: The price authority contains bar opens up to 2026-09-10T23:00:00Z, which is beyond the OI research end (2026-09-10T23:55:00Z bucket start). Both are inside the frozen closed interval; no bar or OI observation after end_ms may be read.

engineering_closure_required.signal_at_the_final_hours: A decision whose exit anchor is beyond end_ms is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA). The last ~72h of the window therefore produce no trades; this is a deliberate, frozen truncation guard, not a data defect.

decision_cadence.cadence: ONE primary decision per certified FUNDING SETTLEMENT INSTANT, per asset (event-driven, not calendar-forced)
decision_cadence.decision_instant_derivation: decision_time = funding_time_ms of each certified funding row of the asset, read from the frozen funding authority (provider-native intervals; SOL 2022-11 2h/4h rows respected)
decision_cadence.eligible_funding_observation: all funding rows with funding_time_ms <= decision_time_ms
decision_cadence.eligible_oi_window: all OI observations with timestamp_ms <= decision_time_ms (5m snapshots)
decision_cadence.informational_justification: funding settles on a fixed provider-native schedule and its value is known exactly at settlement, so settlement instants are the only instants at which a NEW funding observation (the signal input) enters the information set; selecting this cadence decouples decision times from return outcomes

rejected_alternatives.1h_calendar_grid: would evaluate the same funding observation up to 8 times without new funding information (duplicate decisions, inflates N without new information)
rejected_alternatives.5m_calendar_grid: OI resolution is 5m but funding information arrives every 8h; 5m decisions would be funding-blind duplicates

decision_cadence.runtime_defaults: NONE: no hidden default cadence, no fallback calendar; the cadence is exactly the set of certified settlement instants

funding_transform.name: FUNDING_EXTREME_ROBUST_Z
funding_transform.rationale: funding extremeness must be measured relative to the asset's OWN recent distribution: funding level scale differs across assets and eras (BTC vs SOL, 2021 vs 2025) and in absolute terms is not comparable; a robust location/scale pair (median, 1.4826*MAD) is chosen over mean/std because funding rates are quantized, zero-inflated and heavy-tailed
funding_transform.value_at_decision: funding_rate of the settlement row whose funding_time_ms == decision_time_ms (a newly arrived observation, never a stale carry-forward)

lookback.interval: CLOSED [decision_time_ms - 5184000000, decision_time_ms] on funding_time_ms (the current settlement is included)

funding_transform.location_estimator: MEDIAN of the window funding rates
funding_transform.scale_estimator: MAD = median(|x_i - median(x)|) about the same window median
funding_transform.mad_zero_behavior: if MAD == 0 use the fallback scale = SAMPLE STDEV (ddof=1) of the SAME window; if that is also 0 (degenerate distribution) the decision is NO_SIGNAL / SCALE_NONPOSITIVE
funding_transform.threshold_boundary_semantics: INEQUALITY IS INCLUSIVE (a value exactly at +/-2.0 IS extreme)
funding_transform.threshold_rationale: under a light-tailed reference, |z| >= 2 excludes the central ~95.4% two-sided mass; with robust (MAD) scaling the same numeric bound is reached only on genuinely unusual funding for that asset; a threshold of 2.0 was chosen over larger values exclusively on expected-event-budget grounds (see ARC01_SELECTION_RATIONALE.md) and over smaller values on extremeness grounds; NO return, PnL or performance quantity entered this choice

oi_transform.name: OI_CROWDING_EXPANSION_24H
oi_transform.rationale: crowding is an expansion of the position stock, not its level; comparing the same 5m slot 24h earlier removes intraday/open-interest seasonality and any scheduled-mechanics artefact while keeping the comparison PIT-clean

oi_now.definition: sum_open_interest of the LAST OI observation with timestamp_ms <= decision_time_ms
oi_now.staleness_rule: if (decision_time_ms - oi_now.timestamp_ms) > 600000 ms the decision is NO_SIGNAL / OI_MISSING_OR_STALE

oi_reference.definition: sum_open_interest of the LAST OI observation with timestamp_ms <= (decision_time_ms - 86400000)
oi_reference.staleness_rule: if ((decision_time_ms - 86400000) - oi_ref.timestamp_ms) > 600000 ms the decision is NO_SIGNAL / OI_REFERENCE_MISSING_OR_STALE

oi_transform.minimum_observations_detail: exactly one PIT-eligible observation for oi_now and one for oi_reference, each within the 600s staleness bound; no distributional window is required by this freeze
oi_transform.crowding_definition: CROWDING_CONFIRMED <=> EXPANSION holds at a decision whose funding is extreme in the direction implying a crowded side (positive funding => crowded longs; negative funding => crowded shorts)
oi_transform.contraction_behavior: oi_change_24h < 0 => NOT_CONFIRMING => NO_SIGNAL / OI_NOT_EXPANDING (contraction is never treated as crowding for this hypothesis)
oi_transform.magnitude_gate: NONE (deliberate): no arbitrary percentage floor is invented at prereg; magnitude sensitivity is deferred to the frozen robustness plan and cannot alter the primary parameters
oi_transform.value_field: sum_open_interest (BASE_ASSET_UNITS); the USDT-notional field is NOT used

price_context.justification: the hypothesis is a derivatives-positioning unwind claim; price is used ONLY for execution anchoring (entry/exit). Adding a price-rejection/trend leg would import the OHLCV-family information that FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY entries #1/#3/#4/#10/#12 already refute, would make ARC-01 a momentum/mean-reversion hybrid, and is explicitly prohibited by the ARC-01 mission. No filter was added to make the hypothesis look more selective.

signal_rules.SHORT_RULE: z_funding >= +2.0 AND oi_change_24h > 0  => SHORT (extreme positive funding + crowded longs => contrarian unwind down)
signal_rules.LONG_RULE: z_funding <= -2.0 AND oi_change_24h > 0  => LONG (extreme negative funding + crowded shorts => contrarian unwind up)
signal_rules.NO_SIGNAL_RULE: every decision that is not exactly one of the two rules above is NO_SIGNAL; NO_SIGNAL is a first-class outcome, is counted and reported, and is never re-interpreted as a trade
signal_rules.direction_semantics: CONTRARIAN: the trade direction is OPPOSITE to the crowded side implied by the sign of the extreme funding
signal_rules.mutual_exclusivity: z cannot be simultaneously >= +2.0 and <= -2.0; exactly one direction rule can match
signal_rules.reason_code_rule: the FIRST satisfied reason in the frozen order above is recorded for the decision; a signal is emitted only when NO reason applies
signal_rules.insufficient_history: fewer than 90 funding observations in the trailing 60d window => NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FUNDING_HISTORY
signal_rules.mad_zero: MAD == 0 => stdev fallback; stdev == 0 => NO_SIGNAL / SCALE_NONPOSITIVE
signal_rules.funding_not_extreme: |z| < 2.0 (or the funding observation itself missing) => NO_SIGNAL / FUNDING_NOT_EXTREME
signal_rules.conflicting_conditions: there are no conflicting conditions by construction; if the frozen precedence finds no reason but no direction rule matches, the decision is NO_SIGNAL / FUNDING_NOT_EXTREME (fail-closed, never a trade)
signal_rules.stale_data: any required input outside its frozen staleness bound => NO_SIGNAL (fail-closed)
signal_rules.missing_data: any required input absent => NO_SIGNAL (fail-closed); NO interpolation, NO forward-fill, NO synthetic substitution

entry.definition: the first price bar with bar_open_time > decision_time_ms (1h bars); entry_price = that bar's open (kline index 1)
entry.causality: entry_time > decision_time_ms >= every data_time used; SAME-BAR ENTRY AND SAME-BAR LOOK-AHEAD ARE FORBIDDEN
entry.no_decision_on_incomplete_bar: only completed bars (bar_open_time + 3600000 <= decision_time_ms) may inform the decision; the entry bar itself is never read for the decision
entry.fills: single deterministic fill at the bar OPEN price of the entry bar; no intrabar fill model, no slippage model beyond the frozen cost model

exit.definition: exit bar has bar_open_time = entry_bar_open_time + 259200000 ms; exit_price = that bar's open (kline index 1)

holding_period.alternate_primary_horizons: NONE (multiple primary horizons are forbidden; alternatives belong to the frozen robustness plan only)
holding_period.selection_basis: the unwind of a crowded leveraged position is a multi-settlement process: 72h spans 9 consecutive 8h funding settlements, i.e. the shortest horizon on which a crowded side has been charged enough carry to make the unwind decision economically forced, while remaining an event-driven (not trend-following) holding; selected from the funding/OI mechanism, NOT from returns

exit.insufficient_forward_price_data: if the exit bar open time would exceed the common window end (end_ms) the candidate signal is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA); positions are never truncated, marked at an ad-hoc price, or dropped ex post

position_policies.OVERLAPPING_SIGNAL_POLICY: SKIP (a new signal for an asset already holding an open position is DISCARDED, not queued and not pyramided)
position_policies.SAME_ASSET_REENTRY_POLICY: re-entry is allowed only after the previous position's exit_time has been reached; the earliest possible re-entry is the next decision instant at or after exit_time
position_policies.MULTI_ASSET_SIMULTANEOUS_POLICY: assets are INDEPENDENT and may hold simultaneous positions; at most ONE concurrent position per asset and at most THREE concurrent positions overall (one per asset); no cross-asset netting, no cross-asset risk overlay at discovery time
position_policies.position_sizing: equal notional per position in return space: each trade is evaluated as a UNIT-notional return (no compounding, no volatility targeting, no leverage overlay); portfolio aggregation is the equal-weighted mean of trade returns

return_definition.gross_trade_return: direction_sign * (exit_price / entry_price - 1), direction_sign = +1 for LONG, -1 for SHORT
return_definition.funding_cashflow_return: sum over certified funding settlements with entry_time < funding_time_ms <= exit_time of (-direction_sign * funding_rate)
return_definition.cost_return: PRIMARY_ROUND_TRIP_COST_BPS / 10000 applied once per round trip
return_definition.reporting_requirement: BOTH net_trade_return and net_trade_return_ex_funding must be reported; the two must never be conflated

cost_model.definition: 10 bps is the TOTAL modeled round-trip trading friction (single canonical number; not decomposed into per-side fees/slippage)
cost_model.sensitivity_role: FROZEN evaluation scenarios / diagnostics, NOT optimization choices; the primary gates are evaluated at 10 bps
cost_model.funding_cashflow_is_not_a_cost: funding cashflow is a separate real flow (see funding_cashflow_accounting) and is never netted into the 10 bps cost number

funding_cashflow_accounting.signal_use: funding is used as INFORMATION: settlements with funding_time_ms <= decision_time_ms (trailing 60d window, current settlement included)
funding_cashflow_accounting.execution_use: funding is used as CASHFLOW: settlements with entry_time < funding_time_ms <= exit_time (strictly after entry)
funding_cashflow_accounting.windows_disjoint: information window ends at decision_time_ms < entry_time < cashflow window start, therefore no settlement is ever used for BOTH purposes
funding_cashflow_accounting.crosses_settlement: YES - the frozen 72h holding period necessarily crosses at least 9 provider settlements
funding_cashflow_accounting.cashflow_rule: for each certified settlement in (entry_time, exit_time]: cashflow_return = -direction_sign * funding_rate
funding_cashflow_accounting.sign_convention: SHORT (direction_sign = -1) RECEIVES funding when funding_rate > 0; LONG (direction_sign = +1) PAYS funding when funding_rate > 0; both invert for negative rates
funding_cashflow_accounting.notional_basis: constant unit notional fixed at entry (funding applied to the entry notional, no intra-hold notional compounding)
funding_cashflow_accounting.notional_basis_limitation: funding is charged on the real mark-to-market notional in production; using the entry notional is a deliberate, frozen, second-order simplification. Because funding settlement sizes are ~1e-4 of notional and are applied 9 times, the resulting relative deviation is O(1e-4) of the price leg; it cannot be corrected post hoc without the frozen mark-price authority, which is NOT admitted.
funding_cashflow_accounting.no_synthesis: the cashflow uses the SAME certified funding authority rows as the information leg, read at their settlement instants; no reconstructed, interpolated or third-party funding series is allowed

sample_rules.insufficient_sample_policy: if total eligible trades < 120, or any asset has < 40, the outcome is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (terminal FAIL-class; no window extension, no threshold relaxation, no asset reselection to chase N)

orthogonality.assessment_stage: later authorized experiment (NOT executed at prereg)
orthogonality.rule: ARC-01 parameters, direction and thresholds MUST NOT be altered in response to an orthogonality or performance result; a failing orthogonality gate is a FAIL-class outcome for ARC-01, not a redesign prompt

forbidden_after_failure: second attempt under the same hypothesis_id

forbidden_until_discovery_authorized: signal generation on real data for economic purposes
computing returns, PnL, Sharpe, Sortino, profit factor, expectancy or win rate on real data
reading any metric that could influence an economic parameter choice
experiment_invalidation: spec/manifest hash drift, dataset fingerprint drift, cadence drift, or ANY economic execution before this prereg commit is verified => experiment invalid
limitations: Common window starts 2021-12-01 (OI/price bound), so the 2020-2021 funding history is deliberately outside the evaluated window
The last ~72h of the common window yields no trades (frozen forward-data guard)
Funding cashflow is charged on the entry notional (frozen O(1e-4) simplification)
OI authority has documented invalid days; gaps fail closed to NO_SIGNAL, which lowers N and can only be assessed at discovery

The ARC-01 ARU candidate design mentioned a price-rejection leg; PRICE_CONTEXT = NONE is a deliberate, justified narrowing (documented in ARC01_SELECTION_RATIONALE.md and ARC01_FAILED_MEMORY_COLLISION_REVIEW.md)
N is a discovery-time unknown; INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE is a possible terminal outcome
